positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Secret Clearance.  Write enterprise-level distributed architecture Java applications using dependency-injection, inversion of control, and Kubernetes pods.  Execute Python scripts
within a Linux environment.  Write and conduct software integration tests using Windows automation scripts.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Contractor)
positions.description:
Wrote C# REST Web API's for enterprise-level distributed architecture applications using 
dependency-injection and inversion of control.  Wrote WPF full-stack applications using
the MVVM binding model for a pharmacy insurance claim adjudication system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Write C# code using domain-driven design and code-first database migration.  Use dependency injection and inversion of control to create loosely-coupled classes for enterprise-level distributed web applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer -- Contractor
positions.description: Used JQuery, AJAX, JavaScript, ASP.NET, MVC, Bootstrap, Razor, AJAX MVC grids, and HTML5 to create modules for web-based projects, including one that allowed the bulk upload of financial information for loan prequalification.  Wrote SSIS packages to create workflows for updating webservices with financial information.  Used SQL Server to create views, stored procedures, and queries used by the backend tier of web applications.  Used Entity Framework to manipulate relational data

positions.title: Salaried Professional (Software Engineer) -- Contractor
positions.description:
Used JQuery, AJAX, JavaScript, AngularJS, ASP.NET, MVC, Bootstrap, and HTML5 to
create web-based projects.  Wrote VBA applications for Microsoft Access reports and
forms.  Wrote PL-SQL queries for extracting data from Oracle and Microsoft Access
databases. Used Kentico to manage web content.  Used bioinformatics and biostatistics
algorithms to analyze DNA sequencing data gathered from NextGen sequencing data for
medical diagnosis of mitochondrial and other diseases.  Used CLCGenomics software and
other proprietary software to manipulate, analyze, and present DNA sequencing data for 
interpretation by doctors.

positions.title: .NET developer
positions.description: Wrote applications for Meaningful Use Certification.  Write applications that use the HL7 SDK to create HL7 messages.  Write WPF and WCF C# .NET applications that use Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) design pattern and NHibernate.  Write .NET applications that access a SQL Server backend.  Create and maintain tables in SQL Server and write .NET applications that retrieve data from this database and display this data in a UI.  Use JIRA for implementing Agile methodology in SRUM environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop C and C# programs using Microsoft SDK
Develop Java programs utilizing Net Beans IDE
Use Apache Ant and Maven to compile Java programs
Use Borland Star Team as a repository for version control

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description: Write WPF and WCF C# .NET applications that use Telerik RadControls.  Write .NET applications that access a SQL Server backend.  Use Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) design pattern to develop WPF applications.  Create and maintain tables in SQL Server and write .NET applications that retrieve data from this database and display this data in a UI.

positions.title: Senior Consultant ESCC Technical Support
positions.description:
Conduct server maintenance and support for servers running Windows 2003 Server and Unix-based operating systems.  Maintain Areva and OSI Energy Management System 
                          (EMS) surveillance software.  Bring ICCP databases online and failover redundant ICCP
                          databases.  Maintain and debug .NET and Java applications that provide, monitor, and
                          display real-time EMS data on the video wallboard of the Transmission Center.  Provide
                          technical support for both servers and workstations used by NVEnergy Operations center
                          and employee workstations.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Developer
positions.description:
Wrote web-based projects using Java and Javascript.  Used AJAX and have familiarity
with J2EE.  Used servlets (Apache).  Used JUnit testing.  Wrote and debugged Perl applications. Wrote some Lotus Notes programs using LotusScript and Lotus formula language.  Wrote some Documentum development programs that use Documentum as a back-end and Java/JavaScript as a front end.  Used Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and Ajax-enabled components in web-based projects.  Used SQL to query Oracle relational database with Java/JavaScript as a front end.  Used HTML to create website content.  Used Macromedia Fireworks, DreamWeaver, and FreeHand to generate website graphic design.  Created Java class diagrams using UML.  Created documentation for full Software Development Life Cycle.

positions.title: Computer Programmer
positions.description:
Used Visual Studio.NET (VB.NET) and VB 6 to write and maintain software that creates,
 verifies, and updates data files used by factory machines to generate data cards, credit
 cards, and giftcards.  Wrote software that creates labels and carriers used for shipping
 and packaging of datacards.  Used SQL Server and MS Access to create databases and
 database tables used in card verifier programs and carrier printing programs.  Created 
 data files used for card generation, and labels and carriers used for card shipping.  
 Maintained and installed operating systems on various factory machines, including
 Windows 2000 Professional and Windows XP Professional. 

Statistical and Software Analysts, Inc

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description: Wrote and designed projects for the course "Operating Systems".  Taught lectures regarding the system calls and project-related material for Operating Systems. Graded and offered feedback for students' projects.  Held office hours and maintained a course email account to assist students with projects and course-related material.  Wrote, designed, and graded homework.  Graded and offered input for course examinations.  Maintained a course website.  Maintained an Excel Spreadsheet for course grades.  Helped compile data for course accreditation.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Consultant
positions.description: Used Lightwave to create computer medical animations and educational medical software.  Offered consultation regarding the medical aspects of creating medical software.  Worked with a team to generate a three-dimensional working model of the thoracic and abdominal organs of the human body.  Created a working Lightwave animation of human conception.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Helped to write and debug software written in C++ using Borland and SQL Server as a database for nuclear medicine dosing and patient scheduling information. Used SQL to generate queries upon a database.  Helped with computer hardware tasks such as helping to build servers and workstations.  Assisted with technical support for company software.
